## [1.29.0](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/compare/v1.28.0...v1.29.0) (2026-09-24)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **hungryshark:** escape dollar signs in free iap smali snippet ([2e68055](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/commit/2e68055c7f7146a68fb481816b50d7b593a71b88))

### ✨ New Features

* **hungryshark:** add free iap patch ([48affa1](https://github.com/legendsciber/morphe-patches/commit/48affa1cb29c448609dd0d5fb533f756761715be))

patches.name: Extreme Car Driving Add Native Lib
patches.description: Adds libcurrencyhack.so to assets and helper dex.

patches.name: Extreme Car Driving Unlimited Currencies
patches.description: Sets all in-game currencies (diamonds, coins, upgrade points) to 999,999,999 via IL2CPP API.

patches.name: RB4 Premium & Skin Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium, removes ads and unlocks all ball skins.

patches.name: Hungry Shark Free IAP
patches.description: All in-app purchases are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.

patches.name: Hungry Shark Installer Source Fix
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check in the game and its SDKs, so sideloaded installs are treated as store installs and the Google Play Store redirect is fixed.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Ad Removal
patches.description: Completely removes ads: banners and interstitials can never be displayed (CFirebaseAds.showBanners/showInterstitial become no-ops) and ad-free is granted once per app start — loadStore() seeds mAdFree = 1, the native engine's poll grants it and the store's own reset (inappPurchasesProcessed) zeroes the field, so no repeated purchase popups.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Free Store
patches.description: Every store item is granted instantly and free: coins, gems, paints, ad-skips, ad-free and bundles, without launching Google Play billing.

patches.name: Hill Climb Racing Instant Rewarded Video Rewards
patches.description: Rewarded video ads grant their reward instantly without playing the ad: the native engine receives onVideoStartedSuccess + onVideoCompletedSuccess on the GL thread, exactly as if the video had been watched and completed.

patches.name: Dan The Man Free IAP
patches.description: All in-app purchases are granted instantly and free without Google Play billing.

patches.name: Smash Hit Premium Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks premium and all game modes without purchase.

patches.name: Soccer Star Ad Removal
patches.description: Disables ads completely: EnableAD always returns false, interstitials and banners are no-ops, Adjust purchase verification is skipped.

patches.name: Soccer Star Instant Rewarded
patches.description: Rewarded and interstitial ad flows always report loaded and grant the success callback immediately without playing an ad, including offline.

patches.name: Soccer Star VIP Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks VIP subscription permanently: ownership keys always report active and unsubscribe can never clear the flag.

patches.name: Aphelion Ad-Free Hint Unlock
patches.description: Unlocks level hints instantly without watching an ad: the share gate's watch ad action grants the hint immediately, with no ad playback required, even offline.

patches.name: Aphelion Installer Source Fix
patches.description: Spoofs the installer source as Google Play for every install-source check the game performs, so sideloaded installs pass and the forced Google Play Store redirect on launch is fixed.

patches.name: Bypass Google Play Install Check
patches.description: App always behaves as if installed from Google Play, bypassing the install source check.

patches.name: Premium
patches.description: Enables premium features by bypassing in-app purchase verification.
